7. Later on in the series this F will become the supreme F!
title: A world where A dies and F supereme is born!
textContentHtml:
1. Initially it will be shown that F dies in front of A and both A and F shouts and cries.

2. Then A puts on his masks and goes on a ramp page to avenge F. 

3. In the ends it turns out that behind the mask it was always F who was avenging A who dies saving F.

4. The story starts with the perspective of the masked A with the usual changed and harsh voice. 

5. This will be an emotional and sad love story. Parallel to masked F's story will run their backstory. In the mid or near end the death scene of F will be shown but in the end it will be revealed that the one who actually died was not F but A!! 

6. The backstory will show the character developement of F and what led her to take such a drastic step!

7. Later on in the series this F will become the supreme F!
